539: /// Conditional `PUT` that creates one supported timed, non-recurring event
540: /// through the domain service and persists the DAV resource mapping.
541: ///
542: /// Requires `If-None-Match: *`. Fails with 412 when the resource already
543: /// exists, 409 when the client-supplied UID is already mapped in the
544: /// calendar, and rolls back the event when the mapping cannot be written.
545: async fn handle_put_create_event_resource(
546:     accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
547:     session: &DavSession,
548:     principal_id: &str,
549:     calendar: &CaldavCalendar,
550:     resource_name: &str,
551:     request: Request,
552: ) -> Response {
553:     let if_none_match = request
554:         .headers()
555:         .get(header::IF_NONE_MATCH)
556:         .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok());
557:     if if_none_match != Some("*") {
558:         return (
559:             StatusCode::PRECONDITION_REQUIRED,
560:             "If-None-Match: * is required to create a resource",
561:         )
562:             .into_response();
563:     }
564: 
565:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(&calendar.role) else {
566:         return dav_server_error(accounts.metrics());
567:     };
568:     if authorize_calendar_action(
569:         UserStatus::Active,
570:         Some(PlatformRole::User),
571:         Some(role),
572:         CalendarAction::CreateEvent,
573:     ) != AuthorizationDecision::Allow
574:     {
575:         return dav_resource_not_found(accounts.metrics());
576:     }
577: 
578:     let body = match axum::body::to_bytes(request.into_body(), query::MAX_BODY_BYTES).await {
579:         Ok(body) => body,
580:         Err(_) => return dav_oversized_body(accounts.metrics()),
581:     };
582:     let body_str = match std::str::from_utf8(&body) {
583:         Ok(value) => value,
584:         Err(_) => return dav_bad_request(accounts.metrics(), "request body must be UTF-8"),
585:     };
586:     let parsed = match parse_calendar(body_str, IcsParserLimits::default()) {
587:         Ok(parsed) => parsed,
588:         Err(_) => return dav_bad_request(accounts.metrics(), "invalid calendar data"),
589:     };
590:     if parsed.events.is_empty() {
591:         return dav_bad_request(accounts.metrics(), "at least one VEVENT is required");
592:     }
593:     if let Err(message) = validate_dav_write(&parsed) {
594:         return dav_bad_request(accounts.metrics(), message);
595:     }
596:     let masters: Vec<_> = parsed
597:         .events
598:         .iter()
599:         .filter(|event| event.recurrence_id.is_none())
600:         .collect();
601:     if masters.len() != 1 {
602:         return dav_bad_request(accounts.metrics(), "a recurring resource requires exactly one master VEVENT");
603:     }
604:     let master = masters[0];
605:     let exceptions: Vec<_> = parsed
606:         .events
607:         .iter()
608:         .filter(|e| e.recurrence_id.is_some())
609:         .collect();
610:     if exceptions.len() + 1 != parsed.events.len()
611:         || exceptions.iter().any(|event| event.uid != master.uid)
612:     {
613:         return dav_bad_request(accounts.metrics(), "recurring VEVENTs must share one UID");
614:     }
615:     let timing = match &master.timing {
616:         crate::ics::NormalizedTiming::Timed {
617:             starts_at,
618:             ends_at,
619:             timezone,
620:         } => EventTiming::Timed {
621:             start_utc: starts_at.timestamp(),
622:             end_utc: ends_at.timestamp(),
623:             timezone: timezone.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "UTC".to_owned()),
624:         },
625:         crate::ics::NormalizedTiming::AllDay {
626:             start_date,
627:             end_date,
628:         } => EventTiming::AllDay {
629:             start_date: start_date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
630:             end_date: end_date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
631:         },
632:     };
633:     if timing_end_not_after_start(&timing) {
634:         return dav_bad_request(accounts.metrics(), "event end must be after start");
635:     }
636:     let status = match master.status.as_deref() {
637:         Some("TENTATIVE") => EventStatus::Tentative,
638:         Some("CANCELLED") => EventStatus::Cancelled,
639:         _ => EventStatus::Confirmed,
640:     };
641:     if master.summary.trim().is_empty() {
642:         return dav_bad_request(accounts.metrics(), "SUMMARY is required");
643:     }
644:     let client_properties = client_properties_from(master);
645: 
646:     let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
647:     if repository
648:         .resolve_by_name(calendar.calendar_id, resource_name)
649:         .await
650:         .ok()
651:         .flatten()
652:         .is_some()
653:     {
654:         accounts.metrics().record_precondition_failed();
655:         return (StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED, "resource already exists").into_response();
656:     }
657: 
658:     let mutation = EventMutation {
659:         title: master.summary.clone(),
660:         description: master.description.clone(),
661:         location: master.location.clone(),
662:         status,
663:         timing,
664:     };
665:     let event_service = EventService::new_at(accounts.pool().clone(), accounts.now());
666:     let projection = if let Some(rrule) = &master.rrule {
667:         match event_service
668:             .create_recurring(
669:                 session.user_id,
670:                 false,
671:                 calendar.calendar_id,
672:                 mutation,
673:                 rrule.clone(),
674:             )
675:             .await
676:         {
677:             Ok(projection) => projection,
678:             Err(_) => return dav_server_error(accounts.metrics()),
679:         }
680:     } else {
681:         if !exceptions.is_empty() || !master.exdates.is_empty() {
682:             return dav_bad_request(accounts.metrics(), "EXDATE and RECURRENCE-ID require RRULE");
683:         }
684:         match event_service
685:             .create(session.user_id, false, calendar.calendar_id, mutation)
686:             .await
687:         {
688:             Ok(projection) => projection,
689:             Err(_) => return dav_server_error(accounts.metrics()),
690:         }
691:     };
692:     let event_id = projection.id;
693: 
694:     if master.rrule.is_some() {
695:         let mut expected_version = projection.version.unwrap_or(1);
696:         for exdate in &master.exdates {
697:             let result = match exdate {
698:                 crate::ics::NormalizedDateValue::Timed(dt) => event_service
699:                     .delete_occurrence(
700:                         session.user_id,
701:                         false,
702:                         calendar.calendar_id,
703:                         event_id,
704:                         dt.timestamp(),
705:                         expected_version,
706:                     )
707:                     .await,
708:                 crate::ics::NormalizedDateValue::AllDay(date) => event_service
709:                     .delete_all_day_occurrence(
710:                         session.user_id,
711:                         false,
712:                         calendar.calendar_id,
713:                         event_id,
714:                         &date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
715:                         expected_version,
716:                     )
717:                     .await,
718:             };
719:             match result {
720:                 Ok(next_projection) => {
721:                     expected_version = next_projection.version.unwrap_or(expected_version);
722:                 }
723:                 Err(_) => {
724:                     let _ = event_service
725:                         .delete(session.user_id, false, calendar.calendar_id, event_id)
726:                         .await;
727:                     return dav_server_error(accounts.metrics());
728:                 }
729:             }
730:         }
731:         for exception in &exceptions {
732:             let result = match exception.recurrence_id.as_ref().unwrap() {
733:                 crate::ics::NormalizedDateValue::Timed(dt) => {
734:                     let exc_timing = match &exception.timing {
735:                         crate::ics::NormalizedTiming::Timed {
736:                             starts_at,
737:                             ends_at,
738:                             timezone,
739:                         } => EventTiming::Timed {
740:                             start_utc: starts_at.timestamp(),
741:                             end_utc: ends_at.timestamp(),
742:                             timezone: timezone
743:                                 .clone()
744:                                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "UTC".to_owned()),
745:                         },
746:                         crate::ics::NormalizedTiming::AllDay {
747:                             start_date,
748:                             end_date,
749:                         } => EventTiming::AllDay {
750:                             start_date: start_date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
751:                             end_date: end_date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
752:                         },
753:                     };
754:                     let exc_status = match exception.status.as_deref() {
755:                         Some("TENTATIVE") => EventStatus::Tentative,
756:                         Some("CANCELLED") => EventStatus::Cancelled,
757:                         _ => EventStatus::Confirmed,
758:                     };
759:                     event_service
760:                         .update_occurrence(
761:                             session.user_id,
762:                             false,
763:                             calendar.calendar_id,
764:                             event_id,
765:                             crate::event::OccurrenceChange {
766:                                 recurrence_id: dt.timestamp(),
767:                                 expected_version,
768:                                 event: EventMutation {
769:                                     title: exception.summary.clone(),
770:                                     description: exception.description.clone(),
771:                                     location: exception.location.clone(),
772:                                     status: exc_status,
773:                                     timing: exc_timing,
774:                                 },
775:                             },
776:                         )
777:                         .await
778:                 }
779:                 crate::ics::NormalizedDateValue::AllDay(date) => {
780:                     let exc_timing = match &exception.timing {
781:                         crate::ics::NormalizedTiming::Timed {
782:                             starts_at,
783:                             ends_at,
784:                             timezone,
785:                         } => EventTiming::Timed {
786:                             start_utc: starts_at.timestamp(),
787:                             end_utc: ends_at.timestamp(),
788:                             timezone: timezone
789:                                 .clone()
790:                                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "UTC".to_owned()),
791:                         },
792:                         crate::ics::NormalizedTiming::AllDay {
793:                             start_date,
794:                             end_date,
795:                         } => EventTiming::AllDay {
796:                             start_date: start_date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
797:                             end_date: end_date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
798:                         },
799:                     };
800:                     let exc_status = match exception.status.as_deref() {
801:                         Some("TENTATIVE") => EventStatus::Tentative,
802:                         Some("CANCELLED") => EventStatus::Cancelled,
803:                         _ => EventStatus::Confirmed,
804:                     };
805:                     event_service
806:                         .update_all_day_occurrence(
807:                             session.user_id,
808:                             false,
809:                             calendar.calendar_id,
810:                             event_id,
811:                             crate::event::AllDayOccurrenceChange {
812:                                 recurrence_date: date.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
813:                                 expected_version,
814:                                 event: EventMutation {
815:                                     title: exception.summary.clone(),
816:                                     description: exception.description.clone(),
817:                                     location: exception.location.clone(),
818:                                     status: exc_status,
819:                                     timing: exc_timing,
820:                                 },
821:                             },
822:                         )
823:                         .await
824:                 }
825:             };
826:             match result {
827:                 Ok(next_projection) => {
828:                     expected_version = next_projection.version.unwrap_or(expected_version);
829:                 }
830:                 Err(_) => {
831:                     let _ = event_service
832:                         .delete(session.user_id, false, calendar.calendar_id, event_id)
833:                         .await;
834:                     return dav_server_error(accounts.metrics());
835:                 }
836:             }
837:         }
838:     }
839: 
840:     let now = accounts.now();
841:     let resource = match repository
842:         .create_resource(

844:             event_id,
845:             &master.uid,

849:         .await

312: /// Fold a content line to at most 73 octets per RFC 5545 section 3.1.
313: fn fold_line(line: &str) -> String {
314:     const LIMIT: usize = 73;
315:     if line.len() <= LIMIT {
316:         return format!("{line}\r\n");
317:     }
318:     let chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();
319:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(line.len() + 16);
320:     let mut pos = 0;
321:     let mut first = true;
322:     while pos < chars.len() {
323:         let width = if first { LIMIT } else { LIMIT - 1 };
324:         let mut end = pos;
325:         while end < chars.len() {
326:             let segment: String = chars[pos..=end].iter().collect();
327:             if segment.len() > width {
328:                 break;
329:             }
330:             end += 1;
331:         }
332:         if end == pos {
333:             end = pos + 1;
334:         }
335:         let segment: String = chars[pos..end].iter().collect();
336:         if !first {
337:             out.push(' ');
338:         }
339:         out.push_str(&segment);
340:         out.push_str("\r\n");
341:         pos = end;
342:         first = false;
343:     }
344:     out
345: }

152:             .expose()
153:             .chars()
154:             .take(TOKEN_PREFIX_LENGTH)
155:             .collect::<String>();
156:         let token_hash = self
157:             .key
158:             .hash_token(TokenDomain::CaldavConnection, &password);
159:         let mut transaction = self
160:             .pool
161:             .begin()
162:             .await
163:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
164:         let id: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
165:             "INSERT INTO caldav_credentials (
166:                 user_id, label, token_prefix, token_hash, created_at
167:              ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
168:              RETURNING id",
169:         )
170:         .bind(actor_user_id)
171:         .bind(&label)
172:         .bind(&token_prefix)
173:         .bind(token_hash.as_bytes().to_vec())
174:         .bind(now)
175:         .fetch_one(&mut *transaction)
176:         .await
177:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
178:         insert_audit(
179:             &mut transaction,
180:             actor_user_id,
181:             "caldav.credential.issue",
182:             id,
183:             now,
184:         )
185:         .await?;
186:         transaction
187:             .commit()
188:             .await
189:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;

191:             metadata: CredentialMetadata {
192:                 id,
193:                 label,

275:     pub async fn authenticate(
276:         &self,
277:         authorization: &HeaderValue,
278:     ) -> Result<DavSession, CaldavAuthError> {
279:         let (username, password) =
280:             parse_basic_authorization(authorization).ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
281:         let username = username.to_ascii_lowercase();
282:         let token = SecretToken::parse(&password).ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
283:         let token_prefix = password
284:             .chars()
285:             .take(TOKEN_PREFIX_LENGTH)
286:             .collect::<String>();
287:         let user_id: Option<i64> = sqlx::query_scalar(
288:             "SELECT id FROM users WHERE normalized_email = ? AND status = 'active'",
289:         )
290:         .bind(&username)
291:         .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
292:         .await
293:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
294:         let candidates: Vec<(i64, Vec<u8>)> = match user_id {
295:             Some(user_id) => sqlx::query_as(
296:                 "SELECT id, token_hash FROM caldav_credentials
297:                  WHERE user_id = ? AND token_prefix = ? AND revoked_at IS NULL",
298:             )
299:             .bind(user_id)
300:             .bind(&token_prefix)
301:             .fetch_all(&self.pool)
302:             .await
303:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?,
304:             None => Vec::new(),
305:         };
306:         let principal_id: Option<String> = match user_id {
307:             Some(user_id) => {
308:                 sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT principal_id FROM caldav_accounts WHERE user_id = ?")
309:                     .bind(user_id)
310:                     .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
311:                     .await
312:                     .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?
313:             }
314:             None => None,
315:         };
316:         let mut verified: Option<i64> = None;
317:         let mut checked_candidate = false;
318:         for (credential_id, token_hash) in &candidates {
319:             checked_candidate = true;
320:             let expected = crate::security::TokenHash::from_bytes(
321:                 token_hash
322:                     .as_slice()
323:                     .try_into()
324:                     .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?,
325:             );
326:             if self
327:                 .key
328:                 .verify_token(TokenDomain::CaldavConnection, &token, &expected)
329:             {
330:                 verified = Some(*credential_id);
331:                 break;
332:             }
333:         }
334:         if !checked_candidate {
335:             // Verify against a dummy hash so unknown-user, unknown-prefix, and
336:             // wrong-password failures take comparable time and do not reveal
337:             // which lookup failed.
338:             let dummy = crate::security::TokenHash::from_bytes([0_u8; 32]);
339:             let _ = self
340:                 .key
341:                 .verify_token(TokenDomain::CaldavConnection, &token, &dummy);
342:         }
343:         let credential_id = verified.ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
344:         let principal_id = principal_id.ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
345:         let user_id = user_id.ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
346:         let now = (self.clock)();
347:         sqlx::query(
348:             "UPDATE caldav_credentials SET last_used_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND revoked_at IS NULL",
349:         )
350:         .bind(now)
351:         .bind(credential_id)
352:         .execute(&self.pool)
353:         .await
354:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
355:         Ok(DavSession {
356:             user_id,
357:             credential_id,
358:             principal_id,
359:         })
360:     }

547:     /// Encode a change-log revision into an opaque, tamper-evident sync token.
548:     ///
549:     /// The token is `base64url(revision) . base64url(hmac)`. Clients treat it
550:     /// as an opaque string; the server verifies the HMAC before trusting the
551:     /// revision, so a forged or truncated token fails safely.
552:     pub fn encode_sync_token(&self, revision: i64) -> String {
553:         let (revision_bytes, tag) = self.key.sign_sync_revision(revision);
554:         format!(
555:             "{}.{}",
556:             URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.encode(revision_bytes),
557:             URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.encode(tag)
558:         )
559:     }
560: 
561:     /// Decode and verify a sync token, returning the revision it carries.
562:     ///
563:     /// Returns `None` for any malformed, truncated, or tampered token so the
564:     /// caller can fail safely without leaking which check failed.
565:     pub fn decode_sync_token(&self, token: &str) -> Option<i64> {
566:         let (encoded_revision, encoded_tag) = token.split_once('.')?;
567:         let revision_bytes = URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.decode(encoded_revision).ok()?;
568:         let tag = URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.decode(encoded_tag).ok()?;
569:         if revision_bytes.len() != 8 {
570:             return None;
571:         }
572:         if !self.key.verify_sync_revision(&revision_bytes, &tag) {
573:             return None;
574:         }
575:         let mut bytes = [0_u8; 8];
576:         bytes.copy_from_slice(&revision_bytes);
577:         Some(i64::from_be_bytes(bytes))
578:     }
579: }

581: fn parse_basic_authorization(authorization: &HeaderValue) -> Option<(String, String)> {
582:     let encoded = authorization.to_str().ok()?;
583:     let (scheme, credentials) = encoded.split_once(' ')?;
584:     if !scheme.eq_ignore_ascii_case("basic") {
585:         return None;
586:     }
587:     let decoded = STANDARD.decode(credentials).ok()?;
588:     let string = String::from_utf8(decoded).ok()?;
589:     let (username, password) = string.split_once(':')?;
590:     if username.is_empty() || password.is_empty() {
591:         return None;
592:     }
593:     Some((username.to_owned(), password.to_owned()))
594: }

284:                 .push_str(&line[1..]);

286:             lines.push(line.to_owned());
287:         }

289:     if lines.is_empty() {
290:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::Malformed));
291:     }
292:     Ok(lines)

294: fn property(line: &str) -> Result<Property, IcsParseError> {
295:     let (left, value) = line
296:         .split_once(':')
297:         .ok_or(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::Malformed))?;
298:     let mut parts = left.split(';');
299:     let name = parts.next().unwrap().to_ascii_uppercase();
300:     if name.is_empty() || !name.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'-') {
301:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::Malformed));
302:     }
303:     let mut params = HashMap::new();
304:     for part in parts {
305:         let (key, value) = part
306:             .split_once('=')
307:             .ok_or(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::Malformed))?;
308:         if params
309:             .insert(key.to_ascii_uppercase(), value.trim_matches('"').to_owned())
310:             .is_some()
311:         {
312:             return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::Malformed));
313:         }
314:     }
315:     Ok(Property {
316:         name,
317:         params,
318:         value: value.to_owned(),
319:         raw_len: line.len(),
320:     })
321: }

335:         "UID",

504: fn normalize_alarms(
505:     alarms: &[Vec<Property>],

508:     let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(alarms.len());

565: fn date_value(p: &Property) -> Result<NormalizedDateValue, IcsParseError> {

567:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));

593:     end: Option<NormalizedDateValue>,

598:         (NormalizedDateValue::Timed(s), Some(NormalizedDateValue::Timed(e)), None) if e > s => {
599:             Ok(NormalizedTiming::Timed {
600:                 starts_at: s,
601:                 ends_at: e,
602:                 timezone,
603:             })
604:         }
605:         (NormalizedDateValue::Timed(s), None, Some(d)) if d > Duration::zero() => {
606:             Ok(NormalizedTiming::Timed {
607:                 starts_at: s,
608:                 ends_at: s + d,
609:                 timezone,
610:             })
611:         }
612:         (NormalizedDateValue::AllDay(s), Some(NormalizedDateValue::AllDay(e)), None)
613:             if e > s && timezone.is_none() =>
614:         {
615:             Ok(NormalizedTiming::AllDay {
616:                 start_date: s,
617:                 end_date: e,
618:             })
619:         }
620:         (NormalizedDateValue::AllDay(s), None, Some(d))

622:         {

624:                 start_date: s,

633: fn parse_duration(value: &str) -> Result<Duration, IcsParseError> {
634:     if !value.starts_with('P') || value.contains('-') {
635:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
636:     }
637:     let mut seconds = 0_i64;
638:     let mut n = String::new();
639:     for ch in value[1..].chars() {

641:             n.push(ch);
642:             continue;
643:         }
644:         if ch == 'T' {
645:             continue;

651:         seconds = seconds

653:                 'W' => number * 604_800,
654:                 'D' => number * 86_400,
655:                 'H' => number * 3_600,
656:                 'M' => number * 60,
657:                 'S' => number,
658:                 _ => return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent)),

660:             .ok_or(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?;
661:     }
662:     if !n.is_empty() || seconds <= 0 {
663:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));

665:     Ok(Duration::seconds(seconds))

249: /// Parse a `calendar-multiget` REPORT body into its requested hrefs.
250: ///
251: /// Only `<D:href>` elements that are direct children of the root are
252: /// captured. The list is bounded by `MAX_MULTIGET_HREFS`.
253: pub fn parse_calendar_multiget(body: &[u8]) -> Result<CalendarMultiget, QueryError> {
254:     if body.len() > MAX_BODY_BYTES {
255:         return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
256:     }
257:     let text = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| QueryError::MalformedXml)?;
258:     let mut reader = Reader::from_str(text);
259:     reader.config_mut().trim_text(true);
260: 
261:     let mut buf = Vec::new();
262:     let mut root_seen = false;
263:     let mut depth: u32 = 0;
264:     let mut hrefs: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
265:     let mut capturing_href = false;
266:     let mut current_href = String::new();
267: 
268:     loop {
269:         match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
270:             Ok(Event::Start(ref start)) => {
271:                 let local_name_ref = start.local_name();
272:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
273:                 if !root_seen {
274:                     if local != "calendar-multiget" {
275:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
276:                     }
277:                     root_seen = true;
278:                     depth = 1;
279:                     continue;
280:                 }
281:                 depth += 1;
282:                 if depth == 2 && local == "href" {
283:                     capturing_href = true;
284:                     current_href.clear();
285:                 }
286:             }
287:             Ok(Event::Empty(ref empty)) => {
288:                 let local_name_ref = empty.local_name();
289:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
290:                 if !root_seen {
291:                     if local != "calendar-multiget" {
292:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
293:                     }
294:                     root_seen = true;
295:                     continue;
296:                 }
297:                 depth += 1;
298:                 if depth == 2 && local == "href" {
299:                     // Self-closing href carries no text; record it as empty.
300:                     if hrefs.len() >= MAX_MULTIGET_HREFS {
301:                         return Err(QueryError::TooManyHrefs);
302:                     }
303:                     hrefs.push(String::new());
304:                 }
305:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
306:             }
307:             Ok(Event::Text(ref text_event)) => {
308:                 if capturing_href {
309:                     current_href.push_str(text_event.unescape().unwrap_or_default().as_ref());
310:                 }
311:             }
312:             Ok(Event::End(_)) => {
313:                 if capturing_href {
314:                     capturing_href = false;
315:                     if hrefs.len() >= MAX_MULTIGET_HREFS {
316:                         return Err(QueryError::TooManyHrefs);
317:                     }
318:                     hrefs.push(current_href.trim().to_owned());
319:                 }
320:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
321:             }
322:             Ok(Event::Eof) => {
323:                 if depth > 0 {
324:                     return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
325:                 }
326:                 break;
327:             }
328:             Ok(_) => {}
329:             Err(_) => return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml),
330:         }
331:         buf.clear();
332:     }
333: 
334:     if !root_seen {
335:         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
336:     }
337:     if hrefs.is_empty() {
338:         return Err(QueryError::MissingHref);
339:     }
340:     Ok(CalendarMultiget { hrefs })
341: }

343: /// Parse a `sync-collection` REPORT body into its sync token and level.
344: ///
345: /// The `sync-token` element is optional: an absent or empty token requests an
346: /// initial snapshot. The `sync-level` element must be present and equal to 1
347: /// for calendar sync; any other value is rejected.
348: pub fn parse_sync_collection(body: &[u8]) -> Result<SyncCollection, QueryError> {
349:     if body.len() > MAX_BODY_BYTES {
350:         return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
351:     }
352:     let text = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| QueryError::MalformedXml)?;
353:     let mut reader = Reader::from_str(text);
354:     reader.config_mut().trim_text(true);
355: 
356:     let mut buf = Vec::new();
357:     let mut root_seen = false;
358:     let mut depth: u32 = 0;
359:     let mut sync_token: Option<String> = None;
360:     let mut sync_level: Option<u32> = None;
361:     let mut capturing: Option<&'static str> = None;
362:     let mut current = String::new();
363: 
364:     loop {
365:         match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
366:             Ok(Event::Start(ref start)) => {
367:                 let local_name_ref = start.local_name();
368:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
369:                 if !root_seen {
370:                     if local != "sync-collection" {
371:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
372:                     }
373:                     root_seen = true;
374:                     depth = 1;
375:                     continue;
376:                 }
377:                 depth += 1;
378:                 if depth == 2 {
379:                     if local == "sync-token" {
380:                         capturing = Some("token");
381:                         current.clear();
382:                     } else if local == "sync-level" {
383:                         capturing = Some("level");
384:                         current.clear();
385:                     }
386:                 }
387:             }
388:             Ok(Event::Empty(ref empty)) => {
389:                 let local_name_ref = empty.local_name();
390:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
391:                 if !root_seen {
392:                     if local != "sync-collection" {
393:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
394:                     }
395:                     root_seen = true;
396:                     continue;
397:                 }
398:                 depth += 1;
399:                 if depth == 2 && local == "sync-token" {
400:                     // Self-closing sync-token carries no text: initial snapshot.
401:                     sync_token = Some(String::new());
402:                 }
403:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
404:             }
405:             Ok(Event::Text(ref text_event)) => {
406:                 if capturing.is_some() {
407:                     current.push_str(text_event.unescape().unwrap_or_default().as_ref());
408:                 }
409:             }
410:             Ok(Event::End(_)) => {
411:                 if let Some(kind) = capturing {
412:                     capturing = None;
413:                     let value = current.trim().to_owned();
414:                     match kind {
415:                         "token" => {
416:                             sync_token = Some(value);
417:                         }
418:                         "level" => {
419:                             sync_level = value.parse::<u32>().ok();
420:                         }
421:                         _ => {}
422:                     }
423:                 }
424:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
425:             }
426:             Ok(Event::Eof) => {
427:                 if depth > 0 {
428:                     return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
429:                 }
430:                 break;
431:             }
432:             Ok(_) => {}
433:             Err(_) => return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml),
434:         }
435:         buf.clear();
436:     }
437: 
438:     if !root_seen {
439:         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
440:     }
441:     let level = sync_level.ok_or(QueryError::BadSyncLevel)?;
442:     if level != 1 {
443:         return Err(QueryError::BadSyncLevel);
444:     }
445:     let token = sync_token.unwrap_or_default();
446:     Ok(SyncCollection {
447:         sync_token: if token.is_empty() { None } else { Some(token) },
448:         sync_level: level,
449:     })
450: }

452: /// Determine the report type from the body and parse it accordingly.
453: pub fn parse_calendar_report(body: &[u8]) -> Result<CalendarReport, QueryError> {
454:     if body.len() > MAX_BODY_BYTES {
455:         return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
456:     }
457:     let text = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| QueryError::MalformedXml)?;
458:     let root = peek_root(text).ok_or(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot)?;
459:     match root.as_str() {
460:         "calendar-query" => Ok(CalendarReport::Query(parse_calendar_query(body)?)),
461:         "calendar-multiget" => Ok(CalendarReport::Multiget(parse_calendar_multiget(body)?)),
462:         "sync-collection" => Ok(CalendarReport::SyncCollection(parse_sync_collection(body)?)),
463:         _ => Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot),
464:     }
465: }

467: /// Read the first element name in an XML document, if any.
468: fn peek_root(text: &str) -> Option<String> {
469:     let mut reader = Reader::from_str(text);
470:     reader.config_mut().trim_text(true);
471:     let mut buf = Vec::new();
472:     loop {
473:         match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
474:             Ok(Event::Start(ref start)) => {
475:                 return Some(name_to_str(start.local_name().as_ref()).to_owned());
476:             }
477:             Ok(Event::Empty(ref empty)) => {
478:                 return Some(name_to_str(empty.local_name().as_ref()).to_owned());
479:             }
480:             Ok(Event::Eof) => return None,
481:             Ok(_) => {}
482:             Err(_) => return None,
483:         }
484:         buf.clear();
485:     }
486: }

9: /// Render a UTC instant as an ISO calendar date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) in the UTC zone.
10: fn utc_date(utc: i64) -> String {
11:     chrono::DateTime::from_timestamp(utc, 0)
12:         .map(|dt| dt.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string())
13:         .unwrap_or_default()
14: }

16: #[derive(Clone)]
17: pub struct CaldavRepository {
18:     pool: SqlitePool,
19: }
20: 
21: impl CaldavRepository {
22:     pub fn new(pool: SqlitePool) -> Self {
23:         Self { pool }
24:     }
25: 
26:     /// Return the stable DAV identity for an event, creating it on first use.
27:     pub async fn ensure_resource(
28:         &self,
29:         calendar_id: i64,
30:         event_id: i64,
31:         now: i64,
32:     ) -> Result<CaldavEventResource, CaldavAuthError> {
33:         if let Some(resource) = self.resolve_resource(calendar_id, event_id).await? {
34:             return Ok(resource);
35:         }
36:         let uid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
37:         let resource_name = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
38:         sqlx::query(
39:             "INSERT INTO caldav_event_resources (
40:                 event_id, calendar_id, uid, resource_name, created_at, updated_at
41:              ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
42:         )
43:         .bind(event_id)
44:         .bind(calendar_id)
45:         .bind(&uid)
46:         .bind(&resource_name)
47:         .bind(now)
48:         .bind(now)
49:         .execute(&self.pool)
50:         .await
51:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
52:         self.resolve_resource(calendar_id, event_id)
53:             .await?
54:             .ok_or(CaldavAuthError::Persistence)
55:     }
56: 
57:     pub async fn resolve_resource(
58:         &self,
59:         calendar_id: i64,
60:         event_id: i64,
61:     ) -> Result<Option<CaldavEventResource>, CaldavAuthError> {
62:         let row: Option<(Option<i64>, i64, String, String)> = sqlx::query_as(
63:             "SELECT event_id, calendar_id, uid, resource_name
64:              FROM caldav_event_resources
65:              WHERE calendar_id = ? AND event_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL",
66:         )
67:         .bind(calendar_id)
68:         .bind(event_id)
69:         .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
70:         .await
71:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
72:         Ok(row.and_then(|(event_id, calendar_id, uid, resource_name)| {
73:             event_id.map(|event_id| CaldavEventResource {
74:                 event_id,
75:                 calendar_id,
76:                 uid,
77:                 resource_name,
78:             })
79:         }))
80:     }
81: 
82:     pub async fn resolve_by_name(
83:         &self,
84:         calendar_id: i64,
85:         resource_name: &str,
86:     ) -> Result<Option<CaldavEventResource>, CaldavAuthError> {
87:         let row: Option<(Option<i64>, i64, String, String)> = sqlx::query_as(
88:             "SELECT event_id, calendar_id, uid, resource_name
89:              FROM caldav_event_resources
90:              WHERE calendar_id = ? AND resource_name = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL",
91:         )
92:         .bind(calendar_id)
93:         .bind(resource_name)
94:         .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
95:         .await
96:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
97:         Ok(row.and_then(|(event_id, calendar_id, uid, resource_name)| {
98:             event_id.map(|event_id| CaldavEventResource {
99:                 event_id,
100:                 calendar_id,
101:                 uid,
102:                 resource_name,
103:             })
104:         }))
105:     }
106: 
107:     /// Create a DAV resource mapping with a client-supplied UID and resource
108:     /// name. Fails with `ResourceExists` if the name is taken or `UidConflict`
109:     /// if the UID is already mapped in this calendar.
110:     pub async fn create_resource(
111:         &self,
112:         calendar_id: i64,
113:         event_id: i64,
114:         uid: &str,
115:         resource_name: &str,
116:         now: i64,
117:     ) -> Result<CaldavEventResource, CaldavAuthError> {
118:         if self
119:             .resolve_by_name(calendar_id, resource_name)
120:             .await?
121:             .is_some()
122:         {
123:             return Err(CaldavAuthError::ResourceExists);
124:         }
125:         let uid_taken: bool = sqlx::query_scalar(
126:             "SELECT EXISTS(
127:                 SELECT 1 FROM caldav_event_resources
128:                 WHERE calendar_id = ? AND uid = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
129:              )",
130:         )
131:         .bind(calendar_id)
132:         .bind(uid)
133:         .fetch_one(&self.pool)
134:         .await
135:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
136:         if uid_taken {
137:             return Err(CaldavAuthError::UidConflict);
138:         }
139:         sqlx::query(
140:             "INSERT INTO caldav_event_resources (
141:                 event_id, calendar_id, uid, resource_name, created_at, updated_at
142:              ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
143:         )
144:         .bind(event_id)
145:         .bind(calendar_id)
146:         .bind(uid)
147:         .bind(resource_name)
148:         .bind(now)
149:         .bind(now)
150:         .execute(&self.pool)
151:         .await
152:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
153:         self.resolve_by_name(calendar_id, resource_name)
154:             .await?
155:             .ok_or(CaldavAuthError::Persistence)
156:     }
157: 
158:     /// Convert a live resource into a durable tombstone: clear the event
159:     /// reference and stamp the deletion. Returns `true` when a live row was
160:     /// tombstoned, `false` when no live resource matched (already deleted or
161:     /// absent).
162:     pub async fn tombstone_resource(
163:         &self,
164:         calendar_id: i64,
165:         event_id: i64,
166:         now: i64,
167:     ) -> Result<bool, CaldavAuthError> {
168:         let result = sqlx::query(
169:             "UPDATE caldav_event_resources
170:                  SET event_id = NULL, deleted_at = ?, updated_at = ?
171:                WHERE calendar_id = ? AND event_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL",
172:         )
173:         .bind(now)
174:         .bind(now)
175:         .bind(calendar_id)
176:         .bind(event_id)
177:         .execute(&self.pool)
178:         .await
179:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
180:         Ok(result.rows_affected() == 1)
181:     }
182: 
183:     /// Reverse a tombstone: restore the event reference and clear the deletion
184:     /// stamp. Used to compensate when the domain delete fails after the
185:     /// resource was tombstoned. Matches the specific tombstoned row by its
186:     /// resource name so other tombstones in the calendar are untouched.
187:     pub async fn restore_resource(
188:         &self,
189:         calendar_id: i64,
190:         event_id: i64,
191:         resource_name: &str,
192:         now: i64,
193:     ) -> Result<(), CaldavAuthError> {
194:         sqlx::query(
195:             "UPDATE caldav_event_resources
196:                  SET event_id = ?, deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = ?
197:                WHERE calendar_id = ? AND resource_name = ?
198:                  AND event_id IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL",
199:         )
200:         .bind(event_id)
201:         .bind(now)
202:         .bind(calendar_id)
203:         .bind(resource_name)
204:         .execute(&self.pool)
205:         .await
206:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
207:         Ok(())
208:     }
209: 
210:     /// True when a durable tombstone exists for the named resource in this
211:     /// calendar, i.e. the resource was deleted but its mapping was retained.
212:     pub async fn tombstone_exists(
213:         &self,
214:         calendar_id: i64,
215:         resource_name: &str,
216:     ) -> Result<bool, CaldavAuthError> {
217:         let exists: bool = sqlx::query_scalar(
218:             "SELECT EXISTS(
219:                 SELECT 1 FROM caldav_event_resources
220:                 WHERE calendar_id = ? AND resource_name = ? AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
221:              )",
222:         )
223:         .bind(calendar_id)
224:         .bind(resource_name)
225:         .fetch_one(&self.pool)
226:         .await
227:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
228:         Ok(exists)
229:     }
230: 
231:     /// Event IDs currently exposed by this slice: timed and all-day events
232:     /// (recurring and non-recurring) that still exist in the calendar.
233:     /// Callers ensure a stable resource mapping for each before serializing.
234:     pub async fn list_exposed_event_ids(
235:         &self,
236:         calendar_id: i64,
237:     ) -> Result<Vec<i64>, CaldavAuthError> {
238:         let ids: Vec<i64> = sqlx::query_scalar(
239:             "SELECT id FROM events
240:               WHERE calendar_id = ?
241:                 AND event_kind IN ('timed', 'all_day')
242:               ORDER BY id",
243:         )
244:         .bind(calendar_id)
245:         .fetch_all(&self.pool)
246:         .await
247:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
248:         Ok(ids)
249:     }
250: 
251:     /// Event IDs that overlap the given UTC time range, bounded by `limit`.
252:     ///
253:     /// Timed events are matched against their UTC instants; all-day events are
254:     /// matched against their calendar dates (the range endpoints are converted
255:     /// to UTC dates), so a query window that touches a day includes the
256:     /// all-day events spanning that day. Recurring events are included when
257:     /// their series start is before the range end (a safe superset: the
258:     /// caller serializes the full series and the client filters occurrences).
259:     pub async fn list_events_in_range(
260:         &self,
261:         calendar_id: i64,
262:         start_utc: i64,
263:         end_utc: i64,
264:         limit: usize,
265:     ) -> Result<Vec<i64>, CaldavAuthError> {
266:         let start_date = utc_date(start_utc);
267:         let end_date = utc_date(end_utc);
268:         let ids: Vec<i64> = sqlx::query_scalar(
269:             "SELECT id FROM events
270:               WHERE calendar_id = ?
271:                 AND (
272:                      (
273:                          recurrence_rule IS NULL
274:                          AND (
275:                               (
276:                                   event_kind = 'timed'
277:                                   AND timed_start_utc < ?
278:                                   AND timed_end_utc > ?
279:                               )
280:                               OR
281:                               (
282:                                   event_kind = 'all_day'
283:                                   AND all_day_start_date < ?
284:                                   AND all_day_end_date > ?
285:                               )
286:                          )
287:                      )
288:                      OR
289:                      (
290:                          recurrence_rule IS NOT NULL
291:                          AND (
292:                               (event_kind = 'timed' AND timed_start_utc < ?)
293:                               OR
294:                               (event_kind = 'all_day' AND all_day_start_date < ?)
295:                          )
296:                      )
297:                  )
298:               ORDER BY id
299:               LIMIT ?",
300:         )
301:         .bind(calendar_id)
302:         .bind(end_utc)
303:         .bind(start_utc)
304:         .bind(&end_date)
305:         .bind(&start_date)
306:         .bind(end_utc)
307:         .bind(&end_date)
308:         .bind(limit as i64)
309:         .fetch_all(&self.pool)
310:         .await
311:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
312:         Ok(ids)
313:     }
314: 
315:     /// Read the ordered change log for one calendar, starting after the given
316:     /// revision. Returns changes with `id > after_revision` in ascending
317:     /// revision order, bounded by `limit`. This is the ordered change-log
318:     /// input that sync-token paging (T11) builds on.
319:     pub async fn list_changes_since(
320:         &self,
321:         calendar_id: i64,
322:         after_revision: i64,
323:         limit: usize,
324:     ) -> Result<Vec<CaldavEventChange>, CaldavAuthError> {
325:         let rows: Vec<ChangeRow> = sqlx::query_as(
326:             "SELECT id, calendar_id, event_id, change_type, created_at, resource_name
327:               FROM caldav_event_changes
328:               WHERE calendar_id = ? AND id > ?
329:               ORDER BY id
330:               LIMIT ?",
331:         )
332:         .bind(calendar_id)
333:         .bind(after_revision)
334:         .bind(limit as i64)
335:         .fetch_all(&self.pool)
336:         .await
337:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
338:         Ok(rows
339:             .into_iter()
340:             .map(
341:                 |(id, calendar_id, event_id, change_type, created_at, resource_name)| {
342:                     CaldavEventChange {
343:                         id,
344:                         calendar_id,
345:                         event_id,
346:                         change_type,
347:                         created_at,
348:                         resource_name,
349:                     }
350:                 },
351:             )
352:             .collect())
353:     }
354: 
355:     /// Stamp the DAV resource name onto the most recent change-log entry for a
356:     /// calendar. Used by the DAV delete path, where the tombstone is applied
357:     /// before the domain delete records the change, so the name cannot be
358:     /// resolved from the live mapping at record time.
359:     pub async fn stamp_change_resource_name(
360:         &self,
361:         calendar_id: i64,
362:         event_id: i64,
363:         resource_name: &str,
364:     ) -> Result<(), CaldavAuthError> {
365:         sqlx::query(
366:             "UPDATE caldav_event_changes
367:                  SET resource_name = ?
368:                WHERE calendar_id = ? AND event_id = ? AND change_type = 'deleted'
369:                  AND resource_name IS NULL",
370:         )
371:         .bind(resource_name)
372:         .bind(calendar_id)
373:         .bind(event_id)
374:         .execute(&self.pool)
375:         .await
376:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
377:         Ok(())
378:     }
379: 
380:     /// Return the highest change-log revision for a calendar, or 0 when the
381:     /// calendar has no recorded changes. Used to mint the initial snapshot
382:     /// sync token.
383:     pub async fn latest_revision(&self, calendar_id: i64) -> Result<i64, CaldavAuthError> {
384:         let revision: Option<i64> =
385:             sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT MAX(id) FROM caldav_event_changes WHERE calendar_id = ?")
386:                 .bind(calendar_id)
387:                 .fetch_one(&self.pool)
388:                 .await
389:                 .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
390:         Ok(revision.unwrap_or(0))
391:     }

393:     /// Replace the allowlisted client properties for an event (T16). The
394:     /// incoming value is the source of truth: an empty value clears all
395:     /// preserved metadata. The row is upserted so both first-time writes and
396:     /// updates (including explicit removals) are handled uniformly.
397:     pub async fn save_client_properties(
398:         &self,
399:         event_id: i64,
400:         properties: &CaldavClientProperties,
401:         now: i64,
402:     ) -> Result<(), CaldavAuthError> {
403:         let json = serde_json::to_string(properties)
404:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
405:         sqlx::query(
406:             "INSERT INTO caldav_event_properties (event_id, properties_json, updated_at)
407:              VALUES (?, ?, ?)
408:              ON CONFLICT(event_id) DO UPDATE SET
409:                 properties_json = excluded.properties_json,
410:                 updated_at = excluded.updated_at",
411:         )
412:         .bind(event_id)
413:         .bind(&json)
414:         .bind(now)
415:         .execute(&self.pool)
416:         .await
417:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
418:         Ok(())
419:     }
420: 
421:     /// Load the allowlisted client properties for an event, or `None` when no
422:     /// metadata has been preserved.
423:     pub async fn load_client_properties(
424:         &self,
425:         event_id: i64,
426:     ) -> Result<Option<CaldavClientProperties>, CaldavAuthError> {
427:         let row: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
428:             "SELECT properties_json FROM caldav_event_properties WHERE event_id = ?",
429:         )
430:         .bind(event_id)
431:         .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
432:         .await
433:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
434:         let Some(json) = row else {
435:             return Ok(None);
436:         };
437:         let properties: CaldavClientProperties = serde_json::from_str(&json)
438:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
439:         Ok(Some(properties))

input.content:
# Apple Calendar regression fixtures

Sanitized real-client traces captured from current macOS and iOS Calendar
clients. These fixtures encode the protocol shapes the server must accept and
the responses it must return, so regressions in discovery, sync, CRUD, and
revocation are caught by the test suite rather than only by manual device
testing.

## Sanitization

Every fixture is sanitized before it is committed:

- No Apple Account or iCloud credentials appear anywhere.
- Connection passwords are replaced with the placeholder
  `<sanitized-credentials>` inside `Authorization` headers.
- Principal and calendar identifiers are replaced with `<principal>` and
  `<calendar>` placeholders.
- ETags are replaced with `<sanitized-etag>` / `<sanitized-rotated-etag>` /
  `<stale-etag>` placeholders.
- UIDs and event titles use the `@example.test` domain and generic text.

The fixtures therefore contain no real user data and are safe to commit.

## Layout

- `ics/` — ICS bodies the server must parse and round-trip. Each file is a
  single `VCALENDAR` in the shape Apple Calendar sends. The `.fixture.ics`
  suffix marks them as regression fixtures.
- `traces/` — ordered HTTP request/response traces. Each file is a JSON
  document with a `steps` array; every step records the request (method, URI,
  headers, optional body) and the expected response (status, headers, and
  `body_contains` substrings). The `.trace.json` suffix marks them as
  regression traces.

## Trace schema

```json
{
  "name": "connect",
  "description": "human-readable purpose",
  "sanitized": true,
  "steps": [
    {
      "note": "what this step proves",
      "request": {
        "method": "PROPFIND",
        "uri": "/dav/",
        "headers": { "Authorization": "Basic <sanitized-credentials>" },
        "body": "optional raw body"
      },
      "response": {
        "status": 207,
        "headers": { "Content-Type": "application/xml; charset=utf-8" },
        "body_contains": ["substring that must appear in the body"]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

`body_contains` is optional; when present, every listed substring must appear
in the response body. `headers` values are matched exactly.

## Verification

`backend/tests/apple_calendar_fixtures.rs` loads every fixture and asserts:

- each ICS fixture parses through the production `parse_calendar` parser and
  round-trips through the CalDAV serializer with a stable ETag;
- each trace fixture is well-formed JSON with a non-empty `steps` array,
  sanitized placeholders (no real credentials), and valid HTTP methods/statuses.

Run with:

```bash
cargo test --test apple_calendar_fixtures
```

display.text:
## Connect an MCP client

After the MCP HelmRelease has reconciled and `/health/ready` succeeds, connect
clients to the public streamable-HTTP endpoint:

```
https://mcal.hajnal.space/mcp
```

Use a client that supports OAuth-protected MCP servers and streamable HTTP.
Give it the endpoint above; it must discover resource metadata at:

```
https://mcal.hajnal.space/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
```

The client should then start its OAuth authorization flow with the issuer
advertised by that metadata. Do not copy an access token into a configuration
file or share it between users. The client sends its user-specific bearer token
with each `POST /mcp` request; the server resolves that user's grant from
CommonCal core and only exposes permitted calendars and tools.

For a manual smoke test, use an MCP Inspector or another OAuth-capable MCP
client, complete sign-in in its browser window, and run `tools/list`. Then use
`calendar_list` to confirm the client sees only calendars covered by its MCP
grant. If discovery or login fails, first verify:

```bash
curl -fsS https://mcal.hajnal.space/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
curl -fsSI https://mcal.hajnal.space/health/ready
```

`/health/ready` returning `200` confirms MCP SQLite storage is usable; it does
not validate a specific user's OAuth grant. Grant failures must be diagnosed in
the MCP client or CommonCal core, without logging or pasting bearer tokens.

For an emergency direct deployment, first suspend all three Flux HelmReleases,
then run the same script. With all releases suspended (or absent), it deploys
all three workloads directly with Helm and requires `IMAGE_TAG` set to an
immutable `sha-<40 hex commit>` tag. It ensures the `commoncal-tls` TLS
Secret exists and is valid (generating a self-signed certificate on first run
if needed), then deploys all Ingresses referencing that Secret. Resume Flux
only after reconciling the direct deployment back into Git. A mixed state with
any active HelmRelease is rejected to prevent split ownership.

## Images

- Auth: `ghcr.io/david-hajnal/calendar-auth`
- Core: `ghcr.io/david-hajnal/calendar-core`
- MCP: `ghcr.io/david-hajnal/calendar-mcp`

then run the same script. With all releases suspended (or absent), it deploys
all three workloads directly with Helm and requires `IMAGE_TAG` set to an
immutable `sha-<40 hex commit>` tag. It ensures the `commoncal-tls` TLS
Secret exists and is valid (generating a self-signed certificate on first run

only after reconciling the direct deployment back into Git. A mixed state with
any active HelmRelease is rejected to prevent split ownership.

## Connect an Apple Calendar client

Core exposes a real two-way CalDAV account surface on the same origin as the
web app. Apple Calendar on macOS and iOS connects to it as a standard CalDAV
account; Happening is the source of truth and never receives Apple
Account/iCloud credentials.

The DAV root is:

```
https://cal.hajnal.space/dav/
```

Discovery is standards-shaped: `/.well-known/caldav` redirects to the DAV
root, `OPTIONS` advertises the `1, 2, access-control, calendar-access`
capabilities, and the principal/calendar-home `PROPFIND` responses expose the
user's active calendars with their names, colors, and role privileges.

### Issue a connection password

Connection passwords are revocable, per-device secrets. They are shown once
at creation and stored only as a salted hash; the plaintext is never persisted
or logged.

From the web app, open **Settings → Calendar connections** and create a
password for the device. The API equivalent is:

```bash
# Issue a new connection password (returns the plaintext once).
curl -fsS -X POST https://cal.hajnal.space/api/v1/calendar-connections/apple/passwords \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Cookie: <session-cookie>' \
  -d '{"label":"My iPhone"}'
```

The response carries the `username` (the account email), the one-time
`password`, and the `server_url` to enter in the device.

### Add the account on the device

- **macOS:** System Settings → Internet Accounts → Add Account → Other CalDAV
  Account. Server `cal.hajnal.space`, username the account email, password the
  one-time secret.
- **iOS:** Settings → Mail → Accounts → Add Account → Other → Other CalDAV
  Account. Same server, username, and password.

The device then performs discovery, lists the calendars, and syncs events.
Initial sync is a full `sync-collection` snapshot; subsequent syncs are
incremental and carry an opaque sync token. Supported CRUD (create, update,
delete) and all-day and recurring events round-trip through the domain
services, so changes made in Apple Calendar appear in Happening and vice
versa.

### Revoke a connection

Revoking a password immediately invalidates it; the next DAV request from that
device fails with `401`. Revoking one device's password does not affect the
others.

```bash
# Revoke a single connection password.
curl -fsS -X DELETE \
  https://cal.hajnal.space/api/v1/calendar-connections/apple/passwords/<id> \
  -H 'Cookie: <session-cookie>'

# Disconnect all devices (revokes every active password).
curl -fsS -X DELETE https://cal.hajnal.space/api/v1/calendar-connections/apple \
  -H 'Cookie: <session-cookie>'
```

To verify a revocation took effect, a DAV request with the old credentials
must return `401`:

```bash
curl -fsSI -u '<email>:<old-password>' https://cal.hajnal.space/dav/
# expect: HTTP/2 401
```

### Deployment notes

- The CalDAV surface shares the core origin and the two-hop TLS model
  described above; no separate certificate or ingress is required.
- DAV authentication is rate-limited independently of the browser/API routes,
  and request bodies and REPORT payloads are bounded. Logs are redacted and
  never contain credentials or event bodies.
- Public ICS/WebCal export is a one-off convenience and is **not** the
  account-level CalDAV synchronization described here.

+The DAV root is:
+
+```
+https://cal.hajnal.space/dav/
+```
+
+Discovery is standards-shaped: `/.well-known/caldav` redirects to the DAV
+root, `OPTIONS` advertises the `1, 2, access-control, calendar-access`
+capabilities, and the principal/calendar-home `PROPFIND` responses expose the
+user's active calendars with their names, colors, and role privileges.
+
+### Issue a connection password
+
+Connection passwords are revocable, per-device secrets. They are shown once
+at creation and stored only as a salted hash; the plaintext is never persisted
+or logged.
+
+From the web app, open **Settings → Calendar connections** and create a
+password for the device. The API equivalent is:
+
+```bash
+# Issue a new connection password (returns the plaintext once).
+curl -fsS -X POST https://cal.hajnal.space/api/v1/calendar-connections/apple/passwords \
+  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+  -H 'Cookie: <session-cookie>' \
+  -d '{"label":"My iPhone"}'
+```
+
+The response carries the `username` (the account email), the one-time
+`password`, and the `server_url` to enter in the device.
+
+### Add the account on the device
+
+- **macOS:** System Settings → Internet Accounts → Add Account → Other CalDAV
+  Account. Server `cal.hajnal.space`, username the account email, password the
+  one-time secret.
+- **iOS:** Settings → Mail → Accounts → Add Account → Other → Other CalDAV
+  Account. Same server, username, and password.
+
+The device then performs discovery, lists the calendars, and syncs events.
+Initial sync is a full `sync-collection` snapshot; subsequent syncs are
+incremental and carry an opaque sync token. Supported CRUD (create, update,
+delete) and all-day and recurring events round-trip through the domain
+services, so changes made in Apple Calendar appear in Happening and vice
+versa.
+
+### Revoke a connection
+
+Revoking a password immediately invalidates it; the next DAV request from that
+device fails with `401`. Revoking one device's password does not affect the
+others.
+
+```bash
+# Revoke a single connection password.
+curl -fsS -X DELETE \
+  https://cal.hajnal.space/api/v1/calendar-connections/apple/passwords/<id> \
+  -H 'Cookie: <session-cookie>'
+
+# Disconnect all devices (revokes every active password).
+curl -fsS -X DELETE https://cal.hajnal.space/api/v1/calendar-connections/apple \
+  -H 'Cookie: <session-cookie>'
+```
+
+To verify a revocation took effect, a DAV request with the old credentials
+must return `401`:
+
+```bash
+curl -fsSI -u '<email>:<old-password>' https://cal.hajnal.space/dav/
+# expect: HTTP/2 401
+```
+
+### Deployment notes
+
+- The CalDAV surface shares the core origin and the two-hop TLS model
+  described above; no separate certificate or ingress is required.
+- DAV authentication is rate-limited independently of the browser/API routes,
+  and request bodies and REPORT payloads are bounded. Logs are redacted and
+  never contain credentials or event bodies.
+- Public ICS/WebCal export is a one-off convenience and is **not** the
+  account-level CalDAV synchronization described here.
+

 - Auth: `ghcr.io/david-hajnal/calendar-auth`
 - Core: `ghcr.io/david-hajnal/calendar-core`
